title: Wills (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE WILLS ORDINANCE

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Wills (Amendment) Act, No. 5 of 1993.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Wills (Amendment) Act, No. 5 of 1993.

body.heading: Amendment of section 3 of Chapter 60.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 3 of the Wills Ordinance is hereby amended by the substitution for the words " No will made by any male under the age of twenty-one years, or by any female under the age of eighteen years,", of the words "No will made by any person under the age of eighteen years,".
body.text: Section 3 of the Wills Ordinance is hereby amended by the substitution for the words " No will made by any male under the age of twenty-one years, or by any female under the age of eighteen years,", of the words "No will made by any person under the age of eighteen years,".

body.heading: Sinhala text to prevail in case Inconsistency.
body.raw_text: 3. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail-
body.text: In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail-
